name: Spanish Cobras
description: The Insane Spanish Cobras are a primarily Latino (Puerto Rican/Mexican) Folk Nation street gang whose origins are disputed — some accounts cite 1958 in Bridgeport, others point to the early 1970s in East Humboldt Park, Chicago. Richard 'King Cobra' Medina introduced the 'Insane' prefix around 1975 and was killed by Insane Unknowns in 1979. In 1989, the Cobras, Maniac Latin Disciples, and Two Sixers co-founded Spanish Growth and Development (SGD), modeled on the Chicago Outfit to reduce shootings, but it collapsed. The gang operates on Chicago's North and West sides with a presence in Wisconsin, Michigan, Ohio, Connecticut, and Florida, and is led by Anibal 'Tuffy C' Santiago.
